digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler / jira adapter / inbound absence-probe port
propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py) has zero live callers after bug 3b5f removed the producer, dispatch arm, and router.
The port's original purpose (same-pass re-creation of confirmed-deleted issues) is ruled out by an earlier operator decision, making retention of dead surface unjustifiable.
Semantic search (Serena) and string grep both independently confirm no production call site outside the port surface itself exists.

Deletion is safe and behavior-neutral because the outbound probe leaf (_apply_outbound_probe, Direction.outbound dispatch arm) is live and untouched, and deletion detection lives outbound in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue.

The orphaned resolved_statuses config keys are deferred to a separate follow-up ticket (549c-032f-6cb0-4258) because removing documented user-facing keys requires its own deprecate-vs-remove decision.
